# Trailing comma in test signatures: single-line and multiline Test,
# Benchmark, Fuzz, and TestMain shapes with one trailing comma run; an
# extra parameter and a wrong parameter type still fail.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# Single-line trailing comma shapes run.
logos test ./single
stdout '^ok'

# Multiline trailing comma shapes run.
logos test ./multi
stdout '^ok'

# Benchmark shapes with trailing commas are discovered and run.
logos test -bench=. -run=^$ ./single ./multi
stdout '^ok'

# Extra parameter still rejected.
! logos test ./badextra
stderr 'wrong signature'

# Wrong parameter type still rejected.
! logos test ./badtype
stderr 'wrong signature'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/trailingcomma

go 1.27

-- single/p.lgo --
package single

func Add(a, b int) int { return a + b }

-- single/p_test.lgo --
package single

import "testing"
import "os"

func TestSingleComma(t *testing.T,) {
	if Add(1, 2) != 3 {
		t.Fatal("bad add")
	}
}

func BenchmarkSingleComma(b *testing.B,) {
	for i := 0; i < b.N; i++ {
		Add(1, 2)
	}
}

func FuzzSingleComma(f *testing.F,) {
	f.Add(1, 2)
	f.Fuzz(func(t *testing.T, a, b int) {
		Add(a, b)
	})
}

func TestMain(m *testing.M,) {
	os.Exit(m.Run())
}

-- multi/p.lgo --
package multi

func Add(a, b int) int { return a + b }

-- multi/p_test.lgo --
package multi

import "testing"
import "os"

func TestMultiComma(
	t *testing.T,
) {
	if Add(1, 2) != 3 {
		t.Fatal("bad add")
	}
}

func BenchmarkMultiComma(
	b *testing.B,
) {
	for i := 0; i < b.N; i++ {
		Add(1, 2)
	}
}

func FuzzMultiComma(
	f *testing.F,
) {
	f.Add(1, 2)
	f.Fuzz(func(t *testing.T, a, b int) {
		Add(a, b)
	})
}

func TestMain(
	m *testing.M,
) {
	os.Exit(m.Run())
}

package badextra

-- badextra/p_test.lgo --
package badextra

import "testing"

func TestBadExtra(t *testing.T, x int) {
}

package badtype

func TestBadType(t *int,) {
}
